experiment: Exp18c continuation: round-number LR expansion to turnover
authorization_revision: 2026-11-05: continue until all optimizers turn over; use round learning-rate numbers
initialization: Byte-for-byte copies of the five Exp18b CNN initialization files, verified by file and tensor SHA256
dataset: Existing MNIST in repository data/, no downloads or rewrites
privacy: GDP whole fixed-epoch matrix mechanism, add/remove zero-out adjacency, no sampling amplification, three participations spaced by 54 steps

B2LT.source: Byte-for-byte copies of the three audited Exp18b matrices; no optimization

algorithm_version: Exact Exp18 optimizer.Update and noise.OnlineNoise; STP-Ex2 PDF adaptive-alpha third column, d0=1, 24 bisections and 1e-6 backoff; source SHA256 frozen
pairing: Same per-seed initialization, fixed permutation repeated each epoch, CUDA innovation generator seed=seed+1000000; no additional trial seeds
full_trainings: Adaptive: 30 formal trials per unresolved optimizer per round; no fixed round cap
validation: Every finite training: final 6000-record validation at 54,108,162; never open official test during search
selection: Across Exp18b, Exp18c and continuation select common IID/B2LT LR by equally averaged final validation accuracy over two noises and five seeds; ties lower validation loss then lower LR
official_test: Only after all turnover criteria pass, freeze the pooled selection; evaluate 30 selected checkpoints, reusing hash-matched prior official evaluations without repeating them
smoke: Before each round: highest new LR, paired IID/B2LT, seed 20261111, full 162 steps; not formal trials. Numerical divergence is a recorded search boundary, infrastructure errors stop dispatch.
statistics: Five-seed mean, sample SD (ddof=1), Student-t 95% CI; B2LT minus IID paired differences, no multiple-comparison adjustment
release_scope: Per-training epsilon=3 does not make the 90-run composition epsilon=3; validation treated as public; raw training losses/clipping diagnostics are internal non-DP audit artifacts
resume: Reuse complete hash-verified trials and test evaluations; preserve incomplete trials for inspection, archive only after all workers exit, restart whole trial with unchanged config/seed
comparison: Report all pooled IID, B2LT and equally averaged validation curves, turnover witnesses, and pooled final common LR; no test results used in continuation decisions
gpu: Discover all four physical GPU indices and UUIDs with nvidia-smi; bind workers by UUID; memory-based concurrent independent processes, no DDP

expansion.rule: For each unresolved optimizer, take the next three members of mantissa*10**integer strictly above its largest evaluated LR; freeze each round plan before smoke/training
expansion.stop: All three views (IID, B2LT, equal average), for every optimizer: the two highest tested LRs are above the observed valid best LR and both below its accuracy; the highest LR is at least 0.001 absolute accuracy lower. Numerical-divergence endpoints qualify as failed higher candidates; never assign fabricated validation scores.
expansion.interpretation: Descriptive high-LR turnover, not proof of a global maximum or statistical significance; no additional tuning of non-LR hyperparameters
